```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Illustrative example (not paper data). Two characteristics, one hidden (latent) factor, one
// observed factor and an intercept. The start is the plain-ruler section (identity metric); the
// characteristic ruler (Gram metric) M = [[1, rho], [rho, 1]] is applied with the matched
// transformation of Proposition 1 (paper eqs. 3.2-3.4). The fitted value z'h is identical under
// both rulers by construction: 1.00 for stock A and 0.20 for stock B.
viewof csm_toy_rho = Inputs.range([0, 0.95], { value: 0.6, step: 0.05, label: LANG === "zh" ? "两个价值信号的重叠度 ρ（0 为不重叠，1 为完全重叠）" : "Overlap of the two value signals, ρ (0 = none, 1 = full)" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof csm_toy_stock = Inputs.radio(new Map(LANG === "zh"
  ? [["股票 A：两个价值信号都高", "A"], ["股票 B：账面市值比高、另一价值信号低", "B"]]
  : [["Stock A: high on both value signals", "A"], ["Stock B: high book-to-market, low second signal", "B"]]), { value: "A", label: LANG === "zh" ? "股票" : "Stock" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
csm_toy_split = (rho, z) => {
  // plain-ruler section: hidden-factor loading on characteristic 1, retained loadings on characteristic 2
  const b = [1, 0], d = [0, 0.6], a = [0, 0.4], f = 1, g = 1
  const M = [[1, rho], [rho, 1]]
  const Mv = (x) => [M[0][0] * x[0] + M[0][1] * x[1], M[1][0] * x[0] + M[1][1] * x[1]]
  const dot = (x, y) => x[0] * y[0] + x[1] * y[1]
  const R = Math.sqrt(dot(b, Mv(b)))                  // eq. 3.2: normalize the latent loading
  const bM = b.map((x) => x / R)
  const cd = dot(bM, Mv(d)), ca = dot(bM, Mv(a))      // eq. 3.3: overlap of retained loadings with the latent span
  const dM = d.map((x, i) => x - bM[i] * cd), aM = a.map((x, i) => x - bM[i] * ca)
  const fM = R * f + cd * g + ca                      // eq. 3.4: offsetting factor adjustment
  return { latent: dot(z, bM) * fM, observed: dot(z, dM) * g, intercept: dot(z, aM), exposure: dot(aM, Mv(aM)) }
}
csm_toy_z = csm_toy_stock === "A" ? [0.5, 0.5] : [0.5, -0.3]
csm_toy_I = csm_toy_split(0, csm_toy_z)
csm_toy_G = csm_toy_split(csm_toy_rho, csm_toy_z)
csm_toy_parts = LANG === "zh"
  ? [["latent", "潜在因子"], ["observed", "可观测因子"], ["intercept", "截距"]]
  : [["latent", "Hidden factor"], ["observed", "Observed factor"], ["intercept", "Intercept"]]
// Short axis labels (two lines); the table rows carry the full names.
csm_toy_rows = [[LANG === "zh" ? "普通尺子" : "Plain ruler", csm_toy_I], [LANG === "zh" ? `特征尺子\nρ = ${csm_toy_rho.toFixed(2)}` : `Characteristic ruler\nρ = ${csm_toy_rho.toFixed(2)}`, csm_toy_G]]
  .flatMap(([ruler, s]) => csm_toy_parts.map(([k, lab]) => ({ ruler, part: lab, value: s[k] })))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
csm_toy_chart = Plot.plot({
  height: 190, marginLeft: 150, marginRight: 20, marginBottom: 46, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
  ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "图 1：同一个拟合收益，两把尺子（示意）" : "Figure 1: One fitted return, two rulers (illustrative)",
  ariaDescription: LANG === "zh"
    ? "堆叠条形把同一个拟合收益拆成潜在因子、可观测因子和截距三部分，分别用普通尺子和特征尺子。两把尺子下的总数相同。"
    : "Stacked bars split the same fitted return into hidden-factor, observed-factor and intercept parts under the plain ruler and under the characteristic ruler. The total is the same for both rulers.",
  x: { label: LANG === "zh" ? "对拟合收益的贡献（示意单位）" : "Contribution to the fitted return (illustrative units)", labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 40, grid: true },
  y: { label: null, domain: csm_toy_rows.map((d) => d.ruler).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i) },
  color: { domain: csm_toy_parts.map((p) => p[1]), range: [palette.complete, palette.qz_ipca, palette.ipca], legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(csm_toy_rows, Plot.stackX({ x: "value", y: "ruler", fill: "part", order: csm_toy_parts.map((p) => p[1]) })),
    Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: palette.muted }),
    Plot.tickX([{ x: csm_toy_I.latent + csm_toy_I.observed + csm_toy_I.intercept }], { x: "x", stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "4 2" }),
    Plot.tip(csm_toy_rows, Plot.pointerY(Plot.stackX({ x: "value", y: "ruler", title: (d) => `${d.ruler}\n${d.part}: ${fmt2(d.value)}` })))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
csm_toy_table = {
  const zh = LANG === "zh"
  const r = (s) => ({ lat: fmt2(s.latent), obs: fmt2(s.observed), int: fmt2(s.intercept), tot: fmt2(s.latent + s.observed + s.intercept), exp: s.exposure.toFixed(3) })
  const I = r(csm_toy_I), G = r(csm_toy_G)
  return html`<table class="table table-sm"><thead><tr><th></th><th>${zh ? "潜在因子" : "Hidden factor"}</th><th>${zh ? "可观测因子" : "Observed factor"}</th><th>${zh ? "截距" : "Intercept"}</th><th>${zh ? "拟合收益" : "Fitted return"}</th><th>${zh ? "截距暴露（均方）" : "Intercept exposure (mean square)"}</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td>${zh ? "普通尺子（把两个信号视为互不相关）" : "Plain ruler (treats the two signals as unrelated)"}</td><td>${I.lat}</td><td>${I.obs}</td><td>${I.int}</td><td><strong>${I.tot}</strong></td><td>${I.exp}</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${zh ? `特征尺子（按共同选中的股票计重叠，重叠度 ρ = ${csm_toy_rho.toFixed(2)}）` : `Characteristic ruler (counts shared stocks; overlap ρ = ${csm_toy_rho.toFixed(2)})`}</td><td>${G.lat}</td><td>${G.obs}</td><td>${G.int}</td><td><strong>${G.tot}</strong></td><td>${G.exp}</td></tr></tbody></table>`
}
```
